# Jo Minjun

> Project catalog of Jo Minjun (조민준), a product engineer. Each page has a Korean version under `/ko/` and an English version under `/en/`. The links below are the English versions.

## Projects

- [Honey Bloom](https://jo-minjun.github.io/honey-bloom/en/): A mobile puzzle game for iOS and Android. Bees carry nectar into honeycomb cells. Not released yet.
- [Petrify](https://jo-minjun.github.io/petrify/en/): An Obsidian plugin that turns handwritten notes into searchable Obsidian notes.
- [claude-mermaid-view](https://jo-minjun.github.io/claude-mermaid-view/en/): A Claude Code mod that draws the mermaid blocks in Claude's replies as diagrams in the terminal.
- [claude-slack-pane](https://jo-minjun.github.io/claude-slack-pane/en/): A Claude Code mod that reads and sends Slack in a pane beside the Claude Code conversation.
- [work-log](https://jo-minjun.github.io/work-log/en/): A macOS app and agent skill that collect what you did each day into a monthly work log.
- [dotfiles](https://jo-minjun.github.io/dotfiles/en/): A macOS development environment that chezmoi manages.

## Honey Bloom documents

- [Privacy Policy](https://jo-minjun.github.io/honey-bloom/privacy/en/): The data that the app stores and sends, and how the app uses it.
- [Terms of Use](https://jo-minjun.github.io/honey-bloom/terms/en/): The rules for using the app, and how to report a nickname.
- [Support](https://jo-minjun.github.io/honey-bloom/support/en/): How to contact the developer, and FAQ.
